says: In next/, the gateway wakes a finished job's requester with no span open: route is Effect.fnUntraced and the jobs branch opens none, so after the sev1 fix (kamp-us/tea-fabrika#1318) the wake carries no trace and the runner.mailed span starts a new trace, cut off from the finish whose saved traceId comes from the inner gateway.jobs span. AGENTS.md's data-shape rule: the link exists only at write time. Fix: run the whole jobs branch (route and wake) inside one span, so the saved traceId and the wake share a trace. No hands client sends finishes before slice 4, so nothing is lost if this lands first.
proof: Gateway.ts:1114 route = Effect.fnUntraced; Gateway.ts:1175 wakeups.wake(wake) is outside JobRoutes.route's Effect.fn("gateway.jobs") span (Jobs.ts:46); mail.test.ts R2's untraced case asserts the wake's trace is undefined, and it passes at f2ce5eec9.
cost: Each hands finish's wake shows up as an orphan trace, so a slow or lost wake cannot be traced back to its finish.
